mapper.sql: FROM admin_case c LEFT JOIN admin_case_relation r ON r.admin_case_id=c.id AND r.is_primary=1
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC,c.id DESC LIMIT #{page.pageSize} OFFSET #{pageOffset}

SELECT ,c.summary,c.resolution_summary, IF(c.case_type='customer_service',c.closure_checklist_json->'$.resultRefs',NULL) AS refs_json, x.id AS context_id,r.snapshot_json->>'$.demand' AS demand,r.snapshot_json->>'$.mainConflict' AS main_conflict
LEFT JOIN customer_service_context x ON x.admin_case_id=c.id WHERE c.id=#{id}
SELECT COALESCE(c.buyer_user_id,o.buyer_user_id) FROM admin_case c LEFT JOIN rental_order o ON o.id=c.rental_order_id WHERE c.id=#{id}
SELECT id FROM admin_case WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_case SET case_status='closed',active_case_key=NULL,resolution_code='customer_service_resolved', resolution_summary=#{summary},closure_checklist_json=JSON_OBJECT('resultRefs',CAST(#{refs} AS JSON)),closed_at=#{at},closed_by_admin_user_id=#{actor}, version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND case_type='customer_service' AND case_status NOT IN ('closed','cancelled')
UPDATE customer_service_context SET context_status='linked_case',admin_case_id=#{caseId},updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND admin_case_id IS NULL

choose.when: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_coupon WHERE id=#{ref.sourceId} AND user_id=#{user} AND issue_source_type='admin_compensation' AND issue_source_id=#{caseId})
